haiku.problem: The pronoun "him" in "would love him more" could refer to the man or to the moneylender. The moneylender is the one meant, but the nearer noun is "man," so the baker may not be able to tell who is meant.
No question covers Luke 8:1-3, though the title names the women who followed Jesus. Their ministry, card 3-17, was left out while the set kept more questions from 7:36-50.
